method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks mixed as oil prices pause climb but yields hover near highs
Equities.reason: Broad market headline linking equity moves to oil and elevated bond yields. Yields near highs are a direct headwind for equities (higher discount rates/liquidity concerns), so negative directional bias with high relevance for the overall market regime.

Equities.title: Nasdaq 100 Tumbles as Oil Spike, AI Jitters Hit Tech Stocks
Equities.reason: Headline ties tech weakness to both oil moves and AI-related investor jitters — directly signals stress in market leadership (big tech/AI) and risk sentiment. High relevance to equities leadership narrative.

Equities.title: Equities: Hyperscaler stress and chip volatility – Commerzbank
Equities.summary: Commerzbank’s Marco Stoeckle argues that the AI trade is at a crossroads, with ‘Mag 7’ euphoria fading and hyperscalers facing cash flow and leverage concerns. In contrast, semiconductor and memory stocks, tracked by SOX and KOSPI, saw hyperbolic gains before
Equities.reason: Direct thematic piece arguing the AI-led market leadership is under strain (hyperscaler cash-flow/leverage and chip volatility). This challenges the dominant AI euphoria and is highly relevant to equity regime and sector leadership.

Equities.title: JPMorgan report finds dramatic jump in AI-themed ETFs — despite rough quarter
Equities.summary: Wall Street is banking heavily on exchange-traded funds that give investors artificial intelligence exposure, according to JPMorgan Asset Management.
Equities.reason: Flow-driven support for the AI thematic: rising investor demand for AI ETFs is a constructive force for AI-related equity flows. Relevant but more specific to thematic flows than broad market liquidity.

Equities.title: Moody's says 'unprecedented' AI spending threatens credit quality of Amazon, Meta, Alphabet and others
Equities.reason: Credit/financial-risk angle on the biggest equity leaders: heavy, sustained AI capex could impair credit metrics and raise risk premia. This is a significant negative structural signal for big-tech leadership and market risk.

Equities.title: Nvidia locks down memory supply from SK Hynix as part of $500 billion AI deal
Equities.summary: Nvidia is aggressively securing supply of high-bandwidth memory, an essential component for its GPUs and systems.
Equities.reason: Company-level supply-chain move that supports the AI hardware narrative and underwrites Nvidia's leadership in chips/AI. Positive for the AI leadership theme but single-company focus limits relevance.

Equities.title: Nasdaq lags on angst over AI spending ahead of earnings reports
Equities.reason: Market-wide note that investor concern about AI spending is weighing on the Nasdaq into earnings — reinforces the negative narrative about leadership rotation and earnings-driven risk.

Equities.title: Here are 4 forces that drove a tough week for stocks
Equities.summary: Investors navigated everything from escalating tensions in the Middle East to key tech earnings reports to healthcare developments.
Equities.reason: Concise recap linking geopolitics, tech earnings and sector-specific shocks as drivers of a weak week — useful synthesis of cross-market negative forces affecting equities.

Equities.title: US pauses Iran strikes as Oman pursues Hormuz transit deal
Equities.summary: Neither side launches attacks for second consecutive night as mediators seek to avert return to full-blown war
Equities.reason: Geopolitical de-escalation reduces a key tail-risk premium (energy/defense/market risk). Included as a lower-relevance counter-signal that can ease risk-off pressure if sustained.

Equities.title: Big Tech Debt Flood Is Taking Over Risk In Market: Credit Weekly
Equities.reason: Highlights leverage in the largest market-cap names and growing credit-driven risk — reinforces the negative narrative around AI capex, debt and concentration risk in equities.

Rates.title: US investment-grade bond funds see $7 billion record weekly outflows
Rates.reason: Large, record weekly outflows from US IG bond funds are a material demand shock for the bond market, pressuring prices/higher yields — strong negative for Rates.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Higher yields keep upside risks – MUFG
Rates.summary: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny highlights that rising US and global bond yields, elevated geopolitical risks and higher energy prices are supporting the US Dollar.
Rates.reason: Market commentary explicitly links rising US/global bond yields to positioning (USD strength), reinforcing a yields-up / bond-selloff narrative — negative for Rates.

Rates.title: Why bond investors are pushing up some of your interest rates
Rates.summary: Many types of consumer loans such as mortgages peg their interest rate to the yield on 10-year Treasury bonds, which has been moving higher.
Rates.reason: Explains transmission from rising Treasury yields to consumer rates; signals broader persistence of higher market rates — modestly negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Bond market anxiety is growing over AI capex budgets
Rates.summary: Google, Amazon and Meta are seeing credit spreads widen as fixed-income investors demand more reward on companies they lend to.
Rates.reason: Widening credit spreads for large tech increases borrowing costs and reflects risk‑off/term premia in credit markets — negative pressure on fixed-income overall (credit + rates).

Rates.title: Forecasting the upcoming week: Fed, BoE and BoJ decisions take center stage
Rates.summary: The upcoming week will be dominated by monetary policy decisions from the Federal Reserve (Fed), Bank of England (BoE) and Bank of Japan (BoJ).
Rates.reason: Major central-bank meetings raise the risk of 'higher for longer' policy expectations or policy surprises that can keep yields elevated — negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Investors are in the dark about the Fed’s decision this week — and that’s just how Warsh wants it
Rates.reason: Notes Fed's desire for opacity/limited forward guidance — increases uncertainty and potential volatility in rates markets, biasing yields higher or more volatile.

Rates.title: ECB to start implementing enhanced repo facility for central banks
Rates.reason: An enhanced repo facility for central banks is a liquidity/market‑functioning tool that can alleviate short-term funding stress and be supportive for bond markets — modestly positive for Rates.

FX.title: Euro: Choppy range view holds against US Dollar – Rabobank
FX.summary: Rabobank's Senior FX Strategist Jane Foley describes EUR/USD as wary after the July European Central Bank (ECB) meeting. Foley notes that the Euro (EUR) failed to gain support despite a hawkish ECB tone, while the Dollar benefits from safe haven demand and Fed
FX.reason: EUR described as range-bound and vulnerable while USD benefits from safe-haven demand and Fed/market positioning — reinforces dominant USD-strength narrative against EUR.

FX.title: Thai Baht: Oil shock and dovish BoT keep THB pressured against US Dollar – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note that the Thai Baht (THB) is trading near its weakest level in more than a year against the US Dollar (USD), as volatile oil prices, a firmer USD and higher US yields weigh on the currency.
FX.reason: THB weakness explicitly tied to firmer USD, higher US yields and oil volatility — a local-EM currency hit from the broader USD/yield backdrop.

FX.title: US Dollar: Softer yields curb gains ahead of FOMC – Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret say broad US Dollar (USD) gains are moderating as United States (US) yields retreat and risk appetite improves after a tech-led selloff.
FX.reason: Direct USD-focused note: retreating US yields and improved risk appetite are limiting USD upside ahead of FOMC — meaningful near-term influence on FX flows and positioning.

FX.title: British Pound rises as Oil slide softens USD, Fed hike bets increase
FX.summary: The Pound Sterling advances by some 0.20% on Friday as Oil prices tumble, weighing on the US Dollar, while the US-Iran conflict signals a further escalation, which market participants ignored. Despite registering daily gains, the GBP/USD is poised to finish th
FX.reason: GBP strength linked to a weaker USD due to falling oil and shorter-term risk dynamics — a modest currency reaction to commodity-driven USD moves.

FX.title: Euro: Hawkish ECB and strong PMI cap downside – BBH
FX.summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad reports that EUR/USD has recovered part of its recent slump but remains below 1.1400. A stronger-than-expected Eurozone July PMI and a hawkish hold from the ECB support the Euro, though higher Oil prices keep growth
FX.reason: Counter-signal: hawkish ECB and strong PMI provide support to EUR, but relevance is moderate given prevailing USD-strength/safe-haven forces.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar struggles as stronger PMIs support US Dollar
FX.summary: USD/CAD trades around 1.4095 on Friday at the time of writing, up a modest 0.06% as the US Dollar (USD) retains a slight advantage following the release of solid US economic data, while the Canadian Dollar (CAD) remains pressured by weak domestic indicators an
FX.reason: CAD weakness explicitly attributed to stronger US data and USD advantage — aligns with USD-led cross moves and affects commodity-linked FX.

FX.title: British Pound: Strong PMIs and retail rebound in focus – TD Securities
FX.summary: TD Securities notes that the UK Composite PMI climbed back into expansion at 52.1 in July, led by Manufacturing strength and a Services PMI recovery to 51.8. Input cost inflation eased and business confidence hit its highest since February.
FX.reason: Domestic UK data supportive of GBP, but limited USD transmission in this piece so scored with low–moderate relevance.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Multi-decade lows against US Dollar face BoJ risk – Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret note the Japanese Yen (JPY) is slightly firmer versus the US Dollar (USD) but still underperforming most G10 currencies. USD/JPY trades near levels last seen in 1986, with limited resistance overhead.
FX.reason: USD/JPY near multi-decade highs highlights a material USD-dominant narrative and BoJ policy risk — major cross influencing global FX flows and carry positioning.

FX.title: Euro falls even amid strong Eurozone PMIs
FX.summary: EUR/USD trades lower near the 1.1370 area on Friday, struggling despite stronger-than-expected Eurozone business-activity figures. The US Dollar Index (DXY) remains firmer near 101.50, offering limited support to the pair.
FX.reason: Direct confirmation that EUR is losing ground to a firmer DXY despite local data — reinforces USD-strength narrative vs euro.

FX.title: Euro slips as strong US PMI supports Greenback
FX.summary: EUR/USD pares earlier gains on Friday as the widening Middle East war and hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) expectations keep the US Dollar (USD) pinned near recent highs.
FX.reason: EUR weakness tied to stronger US PMI and Fed expectations — another USD-supportive datapoint reinforcing the overall theme.

FX.title: Australian Dollar edges higher after mixed US PMIs
FX.summary: AUD/USD trades higher near the 0.6990 area on Friday, recovering from an earlier pullback as the US Dollar (USD) struggles to gain clear momentum following mixed United States (US) business-activity data.
FX.reason: AUD gains tied to softer USD momentum after mixed US PMIs — modest cross reaction to USD flow and risk appetite.

FX.title: South Korean Won: Strong GDP and inflows support Won – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank reports that South Korea’s advance Q2 GDP rose 0.6% quarter-on-quarter and 3.7% year-on-year, beating expectations. Robust AI-related semiconductor demand and resilient domestic spending underpin growth. The strong data support prospects of a furth
FX.reason: Fundamental domestic outperformance and inflows support KRW versus USD — represents a locally driven FX positive amid broader USD dynamics.

FX.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Kiwi tests 0.5800 as bullish momentum fades
FX.summary: The New Zealand Dollar gains over 0.30% against the US Dollar on Friday. The pair is poised to test key resistance levels with the 50-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) at 0.5793, slightly below the 0.5800 figure.
FX.reason: Price-forecast/technical piece on NZD/USD — relevant to short-term flows but limited structural impact (capped relevance per scoring rules).

FX.title: British Pound: Strong UK data fail to lift GBP against US Dollar – Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret report the British Pound (GBP) is slightly higher versus the US Dollar (USD) but lagging most G10 peers.
FX.reason: GBP underperformance despite solid UK data highlights USD resilience; modest relevance as it reinforces the broader USD-dominant theme.

FX.title: Japanese Yen stays under pressure as resilient US economy supports the Dollar
FX.summary: USD/JPY edges lower on Friday, trading around 163.70, down 0.09% on the day at the time of writing, after hitting a fresh near 40-year high on Thursday.
FX.reason: Reinforces major theme of JPY weakness driven by resilient US economy and USD support; high relevance given impact on global FX positioning and safe-haven/carry flows.

FX.title: Hedge Funds Turn Most Negative on Canadian Dollar Since 2024
FX.reason: Positioning shift by hedge funds toward CAD shorts increases vulnerability of CAD to USD-driven moves — important for USD/CAD outlook and risk of further CAD underperformance.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD consolidates as bulls struggle to clear the 21-day SMA
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) edges higher on Friday as a pullback in Oil prices pushes US Treasury yields lower, while the US Dollar (USD) fluctuates near recent highs. At the time of writing, XAG/USD trades around $58.60, up 2.40% on the day.
Commodities.reason: Short-term bullish technical/price action for silver; precious metals getting support from lower yields and safe-haven flows. Technical piece -> capped relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold gains despite firm US Dollar
Commodities.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) drifts higher on Friday as the Greenback stands firm, even as growing speculation that the US-Iran war may last longer than expected could, in the end, hurt the prospects of the yellow metal. The XAU/USD trades at $4,065, up 0.38%.
Commodities.reason: Safe-haven bid tied to geopolitical risk (US–Iran war) supporting gold despite USD strength; medium relevance for precious metals.

Commodities.title: Energia Costa Azul, Mexico's second LNG terminal, shipped first cargo
Commodities.summary: Energia Costa Azul, the second liquefied natural gas (LNG) export facility in Mexico, shipped its initial cargo from Phase 1 of the terminal on July 8, according to the project developer. The completion of the project adds 0.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d
Commodities.reason: New LNG export capacity increases supply outflows of U.S.-region gas to global markets, exerting modest downward pressure on regional natural gas prices; relevance moderate given small incremental capacity.

Commodities.title: Oil: Supply risks keep prices elevated – BNY
Commodities.summary: BNY’s Geoff Yu notes that Brent has retreated slightly below $100 but remains supported by renewed Middle East tensions, Red Sea and Strait of Hormuz disruptions, and Kazakhstan’s export halt. Institutional flows show high-conviction re-accumulation of energy
Commodities.reason: Clear supply-side narrative (Middle East tensions, transit disruptions, Kazakhstan halt) supporting higher oil prices; institutional flow evidence increases relevance.

Commodities.title: China pours funding into green energy deals as Iran war hits oil demand
Commodities.summary: Beijing’s Belt and Road Initiative takes advantage of rise in appetite for renewables as Middle East conflict drags on
Commodities.reason: Shift into renewables by a major buyer (China) and longer-term demand substitution can weigh on oil demand growth; noteworthy medium-term bearish signal for oil demand.

Commodities.title: Commercial crude oil inventories increased by 2.0 million barrels
Commodities.summary: For the week ending July 17, 2026, commercial crude oil inventories (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) increased 2.0 million barrels to 411.7 million barrels, 6% below the previous five-year (2021–2025) average. Gasoline inventories increased 0.8 mill
Commodities.reason: Weekly inventory build is a direct bearish signal for crude balances; relevance elevated as official EIA data but modest move vs. the broader supply-disruption narrative.

Commodities.title: Oil shipments are under attack on multiple fronts as fighting escalates in Red Sea, Hormuz and Black Sea
Commodities.summary: More than 60 commercial ships have been attacked in the Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz and Gulf of Oman since March 1.
Commodities.reason: Widespread attacks on tanker routes and escalation across multiple chokepoints is a major supply-risk shock for oil; high direction and relevance as a market-moving supply constraint.

Commodities.title: Oil falls on report Pakistan is pushing for new U.S.-Iran talks with China's backing
Commodities.summary: Oil prices dropped by around 3% on Friday, but remained on track for a weekly jump of 10% as the U.S.-Iran war continued to escalate.
Commodities.reason: Headline of de-escalation/negotiation talk reduces immediate risk premium and pressures prices; high immediacy but single-news bearish counter-signal.

Commodities.title: Oil to End Year Near $100 on Mideast Disruptions, Rapidan Says
Commodities.reason: Proprietary/strategy house forecast raising year-end oil price expectations due to Mideast disruptions; reinforces bullish supply-risk narrative.

Commodities.title: Russia’s Top Black Sea Oil Port Halts Loadings Amid Safety Fears
Commodities.reason: Halt at a major export port tightens seaborne flows from a key producer — clear positive for oil price risk premium and market tightness.

Commodities.title: Why aren't oil prices higher? Staggering drop in energy demand leaves strategists puzzled.
Commodities.reason: Article highlights a sharp demand pullback that caps upside for oil despite supply risks; important counter-signal but lower relevance vs. persistent transport-disruption narrative.

Commodities.title: Cocoa prices are easing. So why is chocolate still so expensive?
Commodities.summary: Chocolate firms look to win shoppers back with premium products and social media trends after poor weather conditions, tariffs, and the Iran war hit sales.
Commodities.reason: Price easing in cocoa points to softer fundamentals or inventory relief; directly bearish for cocoa commodity prices.

Commodities.title: US Cattle Herd Grows Slightly in Potential Sign of Rebuilding
Commodities.reason: Slight herd rebuild suggests increased future supply for live cattle, applying downward pressure to cattle prices; relevant to livestock commodity supply dynamics.

Crypto.title: Wall Street Money is Flowing into Ethereum ETFs and Out of Hyperliquid
Crypto.reason: Large institutional flows into Ethereum ETFs are a clear, high-relevance structural demand driver for ETH and reflect continued institutionalization of crypto. This is a positive for ETH price formation and liquidity.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin treasury companies sell up, repay debt, pivot to AI as share prices collapse
Crypto.reason: Corporate bitcoin treasuries selling BTC to shore up balance sheets reduces natural demand from a key buyer cohort and signals risk aversion among bitcoin-holding companies — negative for BTC.

Crypto.title: A $5 billion cluster has formed in bitcoin options. It tells a bullish story
Crypto.reason: Concentrated large options positioning implies bullish skew from sophisticated market participants and can support upside in BTC via realized flows and gamma dynamics.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin holds near $65,000 as $800 billion AI selloff leaves crypto largely untouched
Crypto.reason: Shows resilience of crypto (esp. BTC) to broader tech/AI-driven equity volatility — supports a risk-on narrative for crypto and suggests decoupling from some equity moves.

Crypto.title: Robinhood's New Blockchain Has Been a Smash Success. Here's Why That's Bearish for Ethereum.
Crypto.reason: A competing high-volume retail chain (Robinhood) building its own blockchain can divert transaction volume and retail flows away from Ethereum, presenting competitive headwinds for ETH demand.

Crypto.title: Crypto exchange BitMart to shut down after nine years, BMX token crashes 58%
Crypto.reason: An exchange shutdown and sharp token crash raise counterparty and operational risk in the ecosystem, harming market confidence and liquidity — meaningful negative for crypto sentiment.

Crypto.title: BitMEX faces proposed class-action suit for theft, insider trading as crypto exchange shuts down
Crypto.reason: Legal action against a major exchange heightens regulatory and litigation risk across centralized venues, pressuring trust and institutional participation.

Crypto.title: EU hits Russia with massive 21st sanctions package targeting $120B crypto network
Crypto.reason: A large, coordinated sanctions package aimed at crypto-linked flows materially raises geopolitical and regulatory risks for cross-border crypto usage and could disrupt major on/off ramps — high relevance negative.

Crypto.title: North Korea arrests hackers accused of laundering stolen funds from country's bank via crypto
Crypto.reason: Continued association of crypto with illicit laundering draws enforcement attention and reputational/regulatory scrutiny, a modest negative for the sector.

Crypto.title: Russia’s largest bank Sberbank plans crypto trading infrastructure by December
Crypto.reason: Major traditional-bank entry into crypto trading infrastructure signals institutional adoption and product distribution expansion in a large market — modestly positive for adoption and liquidity.

Crypto.title: Poolin was bitcoin's biggest mining pool and now it's filing for bankruptcy
Crypto.reason: Bankruptcy of a major mining pool underscores miner stress, potential hash-rate centralization and long-term supply-side pressures; negative for mining health and market sentiment.

Crypto.title: Crypto's institutional influx has killed the memecoin craze
Crypto.reason: Institutional capital reallocating toward major liquid assets (BTC/ETH) and away from memecoins indicates maturation of market structure — positive for market stability and large-cap crypto.

Crypto.title: Prediction-Markets Race Heats Up as Robinhood and Crypto.com Hold Talks
Crypto.reason: Competition and product innovation in crypto-native prediction markets could expand on-chain activity and retail engagement, but impact is modest and medium-term.

Crypto.title: Saylor and team overhaul Strategy's bitcoin metrics as bear market persists
Crypto.reason: MicroStrategy revising bitcoin-related metrics signals ongoing pressure on prominent corporate holders and highlights bear-market dynamics — limited but notable negative signal.

Crypto.title: Clarity Act expected to miss its window before Congress' summer break, leadership says
Crypto.reason: Delay to U.S. crypto regulatory clarity prolongs policy uncertainty for institutional participants and product rollout (ETFs, custody), a material negative for near-term institutional flows.

Crypto.title: Crypto market maker B2C2 held sale talks with multiple potential buyers
Crypto.reason: M&A/sale talks for a major market maker indicate potential changes in liquidity provision; this is a modestly negative/uncertain signal for market microstructure.
